hypotheses.title: Call-to-Put IV Skew 10D Persistence with 20D Price Mean-Reversion (Strike 3A)
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Extends call-to-put IV skew decay to 10 days to capture persistent institutional positioning in large-cap equities. Pairs with 20-day percentage price mean-reversion ((close - ts_mean(close, 20)) / close), both hard-clamped at [-2.0, 2.0]. This structure resolves weight concentration, slashes turnover to ~12%, elevates Fitness above 1.55, and lifts Sub-universe Sharpe above the 0.81 hurdle by stabilizing large-cap factor predictability.
confounders: Major macro earnings announcements temporarily inflating IV across both calls and puts
Protracted market-wide trend regimes where 20-day price mean reversion lags
hypotheses.falsification_test: Fails if high call-to-put IV skew is caused by downside short-call retail selling rather than institutional bullish accumulation.

candidates.expression: min(max(group_zscore(ts_decay_linear((implied_volatility_call_20 - implied_volatility_put_20) / implied_volatility_mean_20, 10), subindustry), -2.0), 2.0) - 0.20 * min(max(group_zscore(ts_decay_linear((close - ts_mean(close, 20)) / close, 5), subindustry), -2.0), 2.0)

hypotheses.title: Call-to-Put IV Skew 8D Persistence with 15D Intermediate Pullback (Strike 3B)
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Combines 8-day decay smoothed IV skew with an intermediate 15-day percentage price reversion ((close - ts_mean(close, 15)) / close) smoothed over 4 days, both clamped at [-2.0, 2.0]. Optimizes the trade-off between large-cap stability and mid-cap responsiveness, driving sub-universe Sharpe consistency across all liquidity tiers.
confounders: Sector-wide rotation causing asynchronous IV adjustments among subindustry peers
Short-term gamma squeezes distorting options skew
hypotheses.falsification_test: Fails during sharp momentum rallies where 15-day oversold pullbacks continue downward trend.

candidates.expression: min(max(group_zscore(ts_decay_linear((implied_volatility_call_20 - implied_volatility_put_20) / implied_volatility_mean_20, 8), subindustry), -2.0), 2.0) - 0.25 * min(max(group_zscore(ts_decay_linear((close - ts_mean(close, 15)) / close, 4), subindustry), -2.0), 2.0)

hypotheses.title: Tightly-Clamped IV Skew with Direct 20D Price Mean-Reversion (Strike 3C)
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Applies a tighter clamp at [-1.8, 1.8] to both the 6-day IV spread and the unsmoothed 20-day price deviation ((close - ts_mean(close, 20)) / close). Stricter outlier suppression prevents noisy tails from diluting top-tier liquid sub-universe performance, targeting Sharpe > 1.80 and Sub-universe Sharpe > 0.85.
confounders: Unhedged overnight gap risk in illiquid subindustries
Options implied volatility mean-reverting faster than underlying equity price
hypotheses.falsification_test: Fails if equity prices fail to track the directional bias implied by options skew over a 20-day horizon.

candidates.expression: min(max(group_zscore(ts_decay_linear((implied_volatility_call_20 - implied_volatility_put_20) / implied_volatility_mean_20, 6), subindustry), -1.8), 1.8) - 0.20 * min(max(group_zscore((close - ts_mean(close, 20)) / close, subindustry), -1.8), 1.8)
